Third-party build fixtures
==========================

`Fixtures/Large/Valkyrie.litematic` and `Fixtures/Large/Atrium.litematic` are
Minecraft builds made by other people. They are test fixtures only: they are
never bundled with the app or the Quick Look extension, they are not
redistributed by any release artifact, and the test that reads them is the only
thing in this repository that touches them.

Unlike `Nucleation-LICENSE.txt` and `schematic-mesher-LICENSE.txt`, this file is
not a software license. Both builds were published for others to download and
reuse, so this file records who to credit rather than terms to comply with.


Valkyrie.litematic
------------------

Build
    Space Valkyria 3 V2, a large base in the End on the 2b2t Minecraft server.
    Construction started in early April 2018 and the base was griefed on
    9 May 2019. The wiki describes it as quartz, obsidian, and coloured glass
    around a round core tower inside a torus, with a rainbow road of stained
    glass and five further rings.

Builders
    Credited by the 2b2t wiki as Jacktherippa (founder), AlphaComputer,
    HermeticLock, Kinorana, monaxide, Parthicus, SilverKrownKing, xarviar, and
    xcc2.

Source
    https://2b2t.miraheze.org/wiki/Space_Valkyria_3_V2
    The wiki links a Google Drive download of a world save of the base.

The file here
    Not the world save. A Litematica export made with Minecraft 1.19.4 (data
    version 2865), Litematic format version 6, on 2022-11-26. Its `Author`
    metadata field reads "Isobreeze", which is whoever ran the export, not one
    of the builders above.

Terms
    The 2b2t wiki publishes a world download of the base for public use. The
    build has nine credited contributors, listed above.


Atrium.litematic
----------------

Build
    艾兰德·中庭, a fantasy build published as a large building tutorial.

Author
    正在修行的星雨诺yino, https://space.bilibili.com/19524366

Source
    https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1GA411v7pP/
    【我的世界】---奇幻系建筑艾兰德·中庭（大型建筑教程）, published 2020-07-21,
    for Minecraft 1.12.2.

The file here
    Not the archive linked from the video. A Litematica export made with
    Minecraft 1.20.1 (data version 2586), Litematic format version 5, on
    2023-05-22. Its `Author` metadata field reads "mhy". The build is therefore
    several Minecraft versions and three years newer than the tutorial, and the
    exporting account is not the author.

Terms
    The author distributes the build openly. The video description says
    视频中出现的图纸均上传至动态 and links the 中庭1.12.2 archive on Baidu Pan.
    The 未经作者授权，禁止转载 line further down the page is bilibili's standard
    notice against republication, not a statement about this video: it renders
    among the page's stat tiles, and the description does not repeat it.


Scope
-----

Both files are test fixtures. They are not bundled with the app or the Quick
Look extension, and no release artifact of this project redistributes them. If
either is ever replaced, keep the credit pointing at whoever made the build
rather than at whoever exported the Litematic.
